subject.title: fix(xai): bound stalled generated video download body reads

question: Should xAI generated-video downloads fail on a no-chunk interval equal to 50% of the configured request timeout while retaining the full request timeout as the wall-clock cap?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but repository history does not establish 50% as an existing contract; this changes which slow-but-eventually-successful downloads are accepted.

options.title: Approve the 50% idle budget
options.body: Accept the current derived idle cutoff as a simple plugin-owned policy that guarantees a distinct stall error before the wall-clock guard.

options.title: Choose another idle policy
options.body: Request a named fixed, floored, or differently derived idle budget and update the loopback timing assertions to that owner-approved contract.

options.title: Keep wall-clock-only behavior
options.body: Decline the earlier idle failure and retain current main's generic guarded-request timeout for slow or stalled bodies.

recommendation.title: Approve the 50% idle budget
recommendation.body: Accept the current derived idle cutoff as a simple plugin-owned policy that guarantees a distinct stall error before the wall-clock guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history directly connects this person to generated-video download bounding in xAI and sibling providers.
